questionText:
The emergence of synthetic biology has blurred the historical demarcations between biological organisms and engineered machinery. Rather than merely modifying existing genetic sequences through traditional recombinant methods, synthetic biologists now design entirely novel genetic circuits from scratch, assembling bespoke DNA strands from chemical precursors. In clinical settings, re-engineered immune T-cells equipped with synthetic chimeric receptors have successfully targeted and eradicated refractory hematological malignancies that previously resisted aggressive chemotherapies. However, this profound capacity to fabricate living systems introduces serious biosecurity conundrums regarding dual-use technologies and unforeseen ecological consequences.

According to the passage, synthetic biology differs fundamentally from older genetic engineering because ----.
options: it constructs entirely novel genetic architectures rather than simply tweaking preexisting genomes
it operates without requiring any laboratory synthesis of chemical nucleotides
it has been applied exclusively to veterinary medicine without clinical human trials
it relies solely on natural evolutionary mutations without human intervention
it is incapable of producing effective therapeutics for hematological cancers
explanation: DOĞRU CEVAP: A. Metinde 'Rather than merely modifying existing genetic sequences... design entirely novel genetic circuits from scratch' denilerek eski yöntemlerden farkı açıkça belirtilmiştir.

questionText:
For centuries, the Silk Road functioned not merely as a conduit for silk, spices, and porcelain, but as a dynamic superhighway for intellectual and philosophical cross-pollination. Nestorian Christian scholars translated Greek astronomical manuscripts into Syriac and Persian, which were subsequently preserved and enhanced in Baghdad's House of Wisdom. Concurrently, paper manufacturing techniques migrated from China across Central Asia into the Mediterranean basin, radically democratizing literacy and administrative record-keeping.

It is clearly inferred from the text that the Silk Road ----.
options: exerted a transformative cultural and scholarly influence far exceeding mere material trade
was exclusively controlled by Chinese imperial dynasties throughout antiquity
prevented European societies from gaining access to Hellenistic philosophical treatises
declined rapidly following the invention of paper manufacturing in Damascus
focused primarily on military conquest rather than commercial exchange
explanation: DOĞRU CEVAP: A. Paragrafta İpek Yolu'nun sadece ticari değil, felsefi, bilimsel ve kültürel dönüşümlere yol açtığı vurgulanmaktadır.

questionText:
Deep-sea hydrothermal vents, discovered along midocean ridges, host chemosynthetic ecosystems that flourish in total absence of solar radiation. Instead of relying on chlorophyll-mediated photosynthesis, giant tube worms and vent crabs depend on symbiotic lithotrophic bacteria that metabolize toxic hydrogen sulfide emitted from subterranean volcanic fissures. These bizarre ecosystems challenge our conventional paradigms regarding the prerequisites for habitability across the universe.

We learn from the passage that hydrothermal vent ecosystems ----.
options: sustain intricate food webs through sulfur-oxidizing bacteria rather than solar photosynthesis
can survive only when ambient sunlight penetrates the bathypelagic water column
have been severely depleted by terrestrial pesticide runoff and coastal pollution
produce toxic hydrogen sulfide that inevitably poisons all resident crustaceans
are identical in trophic composition to coral reefs located in tropical lagoons
explanation: DOĞRU CEVAP: A. Paragrafta canlıların fotosentez yerine kemosentetik kükürt bakterileriyle besin zinciri kurduğu açıkça anlatılmıştır.
